title: 第6章 空间种菜-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》
content:
第(1/3)页

    第二天，天不亮王建新就醒了。

    草原上的早晨来得早，六月的天，四点多钟就开始泛白了。他从炕上爬起来，揉揉眼睛，没有像往常那样生火烧水，而是意念一动，直接闪身进了空间。

    空间里亮堂堂的，温度不冷不热，刚好。那条小河哗哗地流着，空气清新得跟洗过似的。王建新走到河边，蹲下来，捧起水洗了把脸。水清凉凉的，浇在脸上那叫一个舒服。

    在苏和家住的时候，洗脸刷牙都得在蒙古包里凑合，水也是省着用。现在好了，空间里这条河就是他的私人浴室，想怎么用就怎么用。

    洗漱完，王建新站起来，看了看河对岸。

    羊群正在那边吃草。十只羊散在牧草地上，低着头，一口一口地啃。那片羊草和披碱草长得密实，羊群吃得挺欢实。

    但他突然想到一个问题——这些羊要是跑到种菜的那边去，那他种的土豆、白菜、萝卜可就全完了。

    王建新走到河边，仔细看了看。

    王建新把青马也牵了过来。青马在空间里待了一宿，精神头不错，毛色都亮了些。他摸了摸马脖子，然后牵着马，意念一动，出了空间。

    一出来，青马就不乐意了。它打了个响鼻，蹄子在地上刨了两下，脑袋直往后扭，想回空间里去。

    王建新乐了，拍拍马脸：“咋的，里头舒服就不想出来干活了？不行，先工作，工作完再回去。”

    青马又打了个响鼻，好像在抗议，但还是老老实实站住了。

    王建新回屋，把那把五六式半自动步枪跨在肩上，又给马套上马鞍，紧了紧肚带。一切准备妥当，他翻身上马，顺着防线开始巡边。

    六月的草原，天亮得早，也热得快。太阳一出来，地面就开始往上返热气。王建新骑着马，沿着铁丝网慢慢走。铁网子歪歪扭扭地立在草原上，有些地方生了锈，有些地方被风刮歪了，但大体上还完整。

    他一边走一边看，注意着铁丝网上有没有破洞，地上有没有脚印，远处有没有人影，顺便把歪了的铁丝网扶正，顺便把木桩敲紧。

    啥也没有。

    除了草，就是草。偶尔能看见几只黄羊远远地跑过去，速度太快，追也追不上。想开枪打，一眨眼便跑没影了。狼没见着，人也没见着。整个草原静得跟没人似的，就剩下马蹄踩在草地上的声音，和风吹过铁丝网发出的呜呜声。

    一圈下来，太阳已经升到头顶了。王建新看了看手表——快中午了。肚子饿得咕咕叫，从早上到现在就喝了点空间里的河水，啥也没吃。

    他骑马往回赶。到了土坯房，把马拴好，枪靠在门边，赶紧生火做饭。

    炉子是铁皮的，好烧。他从补给里找出白面，舀了半碗，加点水和成面团，擀开，切成条。锅里水开了，把面条下进去，煮了几滚，捞出来。

    又从地里拔了颗白菜，烫了几片白菜叶子，用仅有的酱油、醋和盐调了个汁。

    王建新端着碗蹲在门口，吸溜了一口面条。

    他叹了口气。

    他是个厨子，煎炒烹炸样样拿手，一道红烧肉能让人舔盘子。可现在呢？空有一身厨艺，用不上啊。学厨艺的时候，师傅也没教过——啥调料没有，怎么能把东西做好吃？

    面条吃完，汤也喝了。肚子里有东西了，人就有精神了。

    王建新站起来，看了看菜地。

    老周留下的菜地有一亩大，种着土豆、白菜、胡萝卜、大葱、玉米。眼下是六月，白菜已经包心了，绿油油的；土豆苗半人高，开着小白花；胡萝卜的叶子密匝匝的，看着就喜人，虽然长势不算好，稀稀拉拉的，营养也跟不上。但在草原上，这也是稀罕的东西呀。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The next day, Wang Jianxin woke up before dawn.

Morning comes early on the grassland, and the June sky begins to turn white at around four o'clock.He got up from the kang, rubbed his eyes, and instead of lighting a fire and boiling water as usual, he moved directly into the space with a thought.

The space is bright and the temperature is neither cold nor hot, just right.The small river flowed loudly, and the air was as fresh as if it had been washed.Wang Jianxin walked to the river, squatted down, picked up water and washed his face.The water is cool and refreshing, and it feels so good to pour it on your face.

When I lived at Su He’s house, I had to make do with washing my face and brushing my teeth in the yurt, and I also saved water.Now, the river in the space is his private bathroom, and he can use it however he wants.

After washing, Wang Jianxin stood up and looked across the river.

The sheep are grazing over there.Ten sheep were scattered on the pasture, heads lowered, gnawing one bite at a time.The patch of Leymus chinensis and Elymus chinensis grew densely, and the sheep ate quite happily.

But he suddenly thought of a problem - if these sheep ran to the vegetable planting area, the potatoes, cabbage, and radishes he planted would be completely destroyed.

Wang Jianxin walked to the river and took a closer look.

Wang Jianxin also brought the green horse over.The green horse stayed in the space for a whole night. He was in good spirits and his coat was a little brighter.He touched the horse's neck, then led the horse, and with a thought, he left the space.

As soon as he came out, Qingma was not happy.It snorted, dug its hooves on the ground twice, and twisted its head back, trying to get back into space.

Wang Jianxin was happy, and patted the horse's face: "What, you feel so comfortable inside that you don't want to come out to work? No, work first, and then go back after work."

Qingma snorted again, as if protesting, but still stood still.

Wang Jianxin returned to the house, put the Type 56 semi-automatic rifle on his shoulders, put the saddle on the horse, and tightened the girdle.When everything was ready, he got on his horse and started patrolling along the defensive line.

On the grassland in June, the sun rises early and heats up quickly.As soon as the sun comes out, heat begins to rise from the ground.Wang Jianxin rode a horse and walked slowly along the barbed wire fence.The iron net stood crookedly on the grassland. Some places were rusty and some were blown askew by the wind, but generally it was still intact.

He watched as he walked, paying attention to whether there were holes in the barbed wire fence, whether there were footprints on the ground, and whether there were any figures in the distance. He straightened the crooked barbed wire fence and knocked the wooden stakes tightly.

Nothing.

Except for grass, it’s just grass.Occasionally, you can see a few yellow sheep running past, but the speed is too fast to catch up.I wanted to shoot him, but he disappeared in the blink of an eye.No wolf was seen, and no man was seen.The entire grassland was as quiet as if there was no one there. The only sounds left were the sound of horse hooves trampling on the grass and the whine of the wind blowing through the barbed wire fence.

After a circle, the sun has already risen above the head.Wang Jianxin looked at his watch - it was almost noon.My stomach is growling with hunger. I have drank some river water in the space since morning and haven't eaten anything.

He rode back.When we arrived at the adobe house, we tied up our horses, leaned our guns against the door, and quickly made a fire to cook.

The stove is made of iron and is easy to cook.He found white flour from the supplies, scooped out half a bowl, added some water and kneaded it into dough, rolled it out and cut it into strips.When the water in the pot is boiling, put the noodles in, boil for a few times, and take them out.

I pulled a cabbage from the ground, blanched a few cabbage leaves, and made a sauce with the only soy sauce, vinegar and salt.

Wang Jianxin squatted at the door with a bowl in hand and took a sip of noodles.

He sighed.

He is a cook, good at frying and frying, and a dish of braised pork can make people lick the plate.But now?I don’t have any cooking skills, so I can’t use them.When I was learning cooking, my master never taught me how to make something delicious if there were no seasonings.

After finishing the noodles, I also drank the soup.When there is something in the stomach, a person becomes energetic.

Wang Jianxin stood up and looked at the vegetable patch.

The vegetable plot left by Lao Zhou is one acre in size, growing potatoes, cabbage, carrots, green onions, and corn.It's June now, and the cabbage is already packed and green; the potato seedlings are half as tall as a person, with small white flowers in bloom; the carrot leaves are densely packed, which is pleasing to look at, although the growth is not good, sparse, and the nutrition is not up to par.But on the grassland, this is also a rare thing.
